text:
maria: Heads-up — customer wants a hardened on‑prem runtime (FIPS build + customer HSM). Two items: minimal RBAC for runtime -> KMS shim, and a deny-by-default netpol pattern that still allows host/agent talk. Also conntrack guidance and where to keep an HSM runbook.

devin: Use a namespace-scoped ServiceAccount per runtime, Role with only secrets:get and explicit use of the external HSM role (Encrypt/Decrypt, optional Sign). No cluster-admin.

ash: If the shim is local, prefer a unix domain socket. If shim uses TCP on host, run it in a dedicated namespace/DaemonSet with label app=kms-proxy and limit egress to that selector. Avoid hostNetwork unless unavoidable.

sre-jordan: Netpol pattern: default deny egress, add one egress rule from runtime pods to namespaceSelector role=kms-agent and podSelector app=kms-proxy. If agent uses hostNetwork, scope egress to node CIDR not 0.0.0.0/0.

devin: Conntrack: rootless containers + many short TCP connections can exhaust nf_conntrack. Recommend UDS or pooled long lived connections. For onboarding suggest sysctl defaults to request: net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=131072. Provide monitoring on /proc/net/nf_conntrack.

ash: Audit logging: emit structured JSON events (event_type, principal, resource_id hashed with SHA2-256, action, outcome). Never log keys or plaintext ciphertext. In FIPS modes ensure hash algs are FIPS-approved.

sec-bot: Reminder: changes touching kms client code must pass the kms-client risk-review: https://redwood.internal/policies/kms-client-change

ops-liz: Store HSM runbook in private ops repo ops/runbooks/hsm-fallback.md. Playbook: detect -> fail-closed for new decrypts -> alert infra + customer HSM ops -> enable software-fallback behind feature flag -> rotate ephemeral keys if integrity suspect.

maria: Can someone paste minimal RBAC + netpol snippet for docs?

sre-jordan: Short examples below for copy/paste (tweak ports/labels per customer).

# Role (namespace-scoped)
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: runtime-kms-role
  namespace: customer-runtime
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: runtime-kms-binding
  namespace: customer-runtime
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: runtime-sa
  namespace: customer-runtime
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: runtime-kms-role
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io

# NetworkPolicy: allow egress only to kms-proxy
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-egress-to-kms-proxy
  namespace: customer-runtime
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: runtime
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          role: kms-agent-namespace
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: kms-proxy
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 1812

maria: Thanks — I'll add these to onboarding and link the runbook. If anyone can volunteer a test cluster to run a conntrack stress test (10k short TCP opens/min), ping me. :raised_hands:
